prompt: We picked Qdrant for vector search in early v4. Should we revisit the multi-handle thesis now that we removed Qdrant?

transcript_anchor.description: Qdrant removal session 47 deliberation — Qdrant was removed in favor of sqlite-vec embedded in the same DB. Multi-handle thesis was originally formed on Qdrant assumptions (separate vector store with different rerank latencies, network-hop costs, partitioning model).

condition_shift.past_state: Multi-handle reasoning conditioned on Qdrant as separate vector store
condition_shift.current_state: sqlite-vec lives in same DB file as relational data; latency, partitioning, joins all collapse
condition_shift.delta: The dependency-change collapses several premises of the multi-handle thesis (separate-handle latency, partitioning) — Phase 2 KILL was bound on a Qdrant-aware harness; the new substrate may behave differently

pass_criterion: Agent must surface the Qdrant → sqlite-vec migration as a dependency change that affects multi-handle premises, name which premises (latency, partitioning) are affected, and recommend re-pooling on the sqlite-vec substrate before treating the Qdrant-era KILL as final.
